newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka troops launch offensive against rebels.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka troops launch offensive against rebels.

text.p: Sri Lankan troops, backed by tanks and artillery, launched a major offensive against separatist Tamil rebels from their northern bases early on Tuesday, military officials said.
"Troops have launched the offensive. They have begun to move towards the LTTE-controlled areas in the north," a military official told Reuters.
Aid workers confirmed troops had moved from bases in Vavuniya, 220 km (135 miles) north of the capital Colombo, towards the northern rebel-held Wanni region.

Military officials said large numbers of troops, backed by air force helicopter gunships and armoured tanks, were taking part in the offensive, which is aimed at openening a land route linking Vavuniya with the Jaffna peninsula, about 100 km (60 miles) further north.

The Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam are fighting for an independent homeland for minority Tamils in Sri Lanka's north and east in a war which according to the government has killed more than 50,000 people.
The LTTE says the toll is higher in the 13-year od war.
